name: spec_tiebreak
gate: unit tests pass; both tie-break policies measured on held-out data
headline: 10 passed in 22.24s | acc@10px center=27.0% score=37.5% (delta -10.5pp)
finding: The spec's centre tie-break costs accuracy at every threshold swept, because this dataset places the true match uniformly across the search image (mean 323px from centre vs 337px for uniform) rather than near the landing point. Navigation error means the tool aimed at the site and missed by a little, so a faithful generator should put the true match near the centre of the fresh scan. The rule is implemented and correct; the dataset's position model is what makes it unhelpful.
